Discharge Instructions - Right Knee Replacement
Name: Marcus Bell

MEDICATIONS
Cephalexin 500 mg capsule - take 1 capsule by mouth 4 times a day for 7 days
Oxycodone 5 mg tablet - take 1 tablet every 6 hours as needed for severe pain
Aspirin 81 mg (baby aspirin) - take 1 tablet twice a day for 35 days to prevent blood clots

ACTIVITY
Do not drive for 2 weeks after surgery or while taking oxycodone.
You may shower 2 days after surgery. Do not soak in a tub.

FOLLOW UP
Check-up with Dr. Patel on November 17, 2026 at 2:30 PM, Orthopedic Office, (201) 555-0142

Call your surgeon if you have a fever over 101 F or redness at the incision.
